name: Macquarie Technology Group Limited
summary: Macquarie Technology Group Limited provides telecommunication, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and data center services to corporate and government customers in Australia. It operates through three segments; Cloud Services and Government; Data Centres; and Telecom. The company offers voice services, such as teams calling, unified communications, and video and Web conferencing services, as well as Hello, a cloud-based hosted voice system; mobile; SASE that delivers up-to date attack protection in real time; nbn; SD-Lan, an AI-driven business Wi-Fi; SD-WAN, and Azure; Caudit, hybrid, and private cloud services; and hyperscale, liquid cooling, and tier 3 design and facility services; and manage…
